text: Based on the tool outputs, the tree-cover loss observed in 2021 was highly likely caused by timber harvest of the pine plantation. The event area was almost entirely mapped as forest in 2020 (98%) and the forest type was planted pine (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). The loss area was 81.3 hectares, with 68.1 hectares identified as planted forest. The remaining 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest, and 37.3 hectares of loss in patches under 0.5 ha were not counted as an event. Therefore, the evidence strongly suggests that the loss was due to timber harvest.
